name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-06-23, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.49 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
